routine.title: Demo: Air login and a DevOps work item
routine.description: Two steps: the routine browser signs in to the Air test site and saves a screenshot; then the work item is read from DevOps with the package's PAT. Replace every <set-by-user> value before running.

steps.title: Air login and screenshot
steps.prompt: Open https://dent-1.test.air.orisline.com/ with the routine-browser navigate tool. The runtime signs in by itself: never type a password. When the Air home page is shown, call the screenshot tool with the name air-home, then write the page title in the summary.

steps.title: Read the DevOps work item
steps.prompt: Read work item {{workItem}} with the routine-devops get_work_item tool. Save its title, type and state in evidence/work-item.md and write them in the summary. Change nothing on DevOps.
